say:0:1311029001:0.text: There is an acolyte who has been bound.
say:0:1311029001:0.source_cn: 那里，有个被绑起来的修士。

say:1:1311029002:0.text: Let us save him. He's on the verge of collapse.
say:1:1311029002:0.source_cn: 得赶紧去救他，他很虚弱了。
say:1:1311029002:0.male: Let us save him. He's on the verge of collapse.
say:1:1311029002:0.female: Let us save him. He's on the verge of collapse.
